objective: Check whether the reported balanced accuracy for the fraud detector really reflects the balanced class-weight training described.
defect: train.py:27-35: the per-sample class weights `sw` are computed from config class_weight=balanced but never used in the gradient, so training is unweighted; the model rarely predicts fraud (low recall) and balanced accuracy is far below the README claim.
evidence: Ran `python train.py`: accuracy 0.9475, balanced_accuracy 0.5636, recall_fraud 0.1293 (fraud rate 0.058); README claims balanced accuracy 0.74. Fixed copy (gradient error multiplied by the computed sample weights): accuracy 0.783, balanced_accuracy 0.7432, recall_fraud 0.6983.
